## Checklist

- [ ] `stylua --check .` is clean (tabs, width 2) and `luacheck` passes.

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated for any notable change.
- [ ] README updated if features, prerequisites, or keybindings changed.
- [ ] `lazy-lock.json` committed alongside any plugin add/remove/update.
